# Harness Rig Knowledge Base

Canonical planning baseline for a minimum-sufficient, OpenSpec-first, Skill-Kit-knowledge-base-first engineering control plane. Current progressive revision: M5 / r8.5 PASS; Context has one canonical knowledge owner plus one root-projection lifecycle owner. AuthorityRef, AuthorizationGrant, and StateIdentity remain Stable v1; EvidenceReceipt and AcceptanceVerdict remain Experimental shared. Resume at M6-T01 only when M6 is explicitly requested.
